payload.core_mechanism_summary: Single-pass loop over mirrors updating probability of reaching current state and expected days contribution, derived from a 1D DP recurrence.
payload.rationale: The code solves the recurrence E_i = 1 + (p_i/100)*E_{i+1} + ((100-p_i)/100)*E_1 using two running variables. This is a 1D DP on the mirror index, compressed to O(1) space.
